list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (names, descriptions and grades as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase, 2026-11-18; hidden flags follow PSNProfiles / Insider Gaming's split of the list). Guide text is original to this entry; every method below names its source, and methods no source has confirmed yet are marked unconfirmed.

gta.name: GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

pyx.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (difficulty 4/10, ~200 hours)

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: finish the story first, then the 100% completion checklist, then the Strangers & Freaks strands and the miscellaneous trophies. Expect around 200 hours in total; the difficulty is rated 4/10, so the grind is time, not skill.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Play the story through to the final mission (stage 1 of the roadmap).
Clear the 100% completion checklist in free roam (stage 2).
Finish the stranger strands and any miscellaneous trophies left (stage 3).

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, the first mission of the game. It unlocks as part of the story, so just play through the opening as Jason and Lucia.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete every mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do the optional balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in Chapter 1 that may not come back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Finish all Chapter 1 missions.
Before leaving Chapter 1, complete Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house.

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete every mission in Chapter 2. From this chapter on you can play as both Jason and Lucia, and the last meditation spot only opens once you can switch between them, so keep swapping characters as the story allows.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Finish all Chapter 2 missions.

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete every mission in Chapter 3. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — there is no mission replay, so a chapter save is your only way back if you miss an optional interaction.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Finish all Chapter 3 missions.
Keep a manual save at the end of the chapter.

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete every mission in Chapter 4. This is the chapter where the eight large bank vaults open up through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — clear them while you are here, since they feed both Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Finish all Chapter 4 missions.
Run the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to open the bank vaults.

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish the final story mission, which closes Chapter 5. Once it pops, free roam stays open, so everything you have not finished — collectibles, challenges, stranger strands — can still be done afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish the final story mission.
After the credits, keep playing in free roam for cleanup.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story. Like every mission trophy, it pops when the mission ends, with no extra objective to meet.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the story's big set-pieces; play through it normally and the trophy follows at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission completes — no side objective or rating is needed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Complete the story mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Headliners. Just play the mission through to its conclusion.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Complete the story mission Headliners.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy happens, so learn the runways and terminals while you are here.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Play it through to the end and the trophy pops with the mission complete screen.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: The longest trophy in the set: reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which opens after the story. You do not need to find everything in the game — only the checklist's numbers count, and most categories ask for a portion of the total (for example 15 of 18 card sets, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts). Robberies are the exception: all 39 Gang Operations, all 22 Bank Jobs, all 7 Payday Loan Jobs and all 8 bank vaults are required, along with all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, all 42 Drone Time Trials and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work down the list.
Clear every robbery first: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults.
Then the fixed counts: 42 Shooting Range golds, 42 Drone Time Trials, 15 Target Decks, 33 underwater discoveries.
Fill the partial categories only to their checklist number — stop at 15 card sets, 100 flamingos, 200 vehicles, 100 animals, 70 challenges.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, airtime and the other stunt categories the game tracks. Stunts count from the start of the game, so drive aggressively whenever you travel instead of saving them for a cleanup session. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 of 397 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Do stunts naturally while travelling: jumps, long airtime, near misses.
Check Progress > Stats for your stunt total and the categories still missing.
Push on to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — one go at a race, the shooting range, fishing, an arcade game, pool, mini golf, basketball, a drone race and a meditation is enough. You do not need to win or finish anything; sampling each activity ticks it off. Most of these also feed other trophies, so this one usually pops on its own during stage 1.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Sample one of each activity type: race, shooting range, fishing, arcade, pool, mini golf, basketball, drone race, meditation.
Check Progress > Stats to see which types are still untried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are no shortcuts: every challenge needs a gold, and all 42 are also required for the 100% checklist, so treat this as a core stage-2 job. Learn each range's target pattern, use the weapon the challenge gives you, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold clears — scores only improve with familiarity.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit every shooting range and work through its challenges.
Replay any challenge below gold until the gold score clears.
All 42 golds are needed — none can be skipped.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location also hosts Drone Time Trials — 42 in total, all required for 100% — so run the time trials at a location first to learn its course, then win its race. Winning needs a clean run through the gates, so memorise the course before pushing for speed.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Run the Drone Time Trials at each of the 14 locations to learn the courses.
Win one drone race at every location.
All 42 time trials also count toward 100% — clear those too.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins on the same track. There are 40 races in total and the 100% checklist wants 30 of them won, so keep racing past 20. Pick a fast car you handle well, learn the braking points, and use the rewind-free racing line the game shows you.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races across Leonida.
Keep going to 30 wins for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: catch the target fish before Cal does, or outscore him in the time allowed. Use the best rod and bait you own, watch the water for the strike marker, and reel steadily — snapping the line costs more time than a slow reel. Cal shows up as a fishing rival, so look for his challenge marker near fishing spots.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find a fishing challenge against Cal.
Out-catch him before the time runs out — steady reeling beats fast reeling.

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Arcade cabinets are scattered around Leonida — sit down at one and play it through to its end screen. Any game counts, so pick the shortest. Playing all four video games is also a 100% checklist item, so this trophy is a free step toward A Long Road.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet and play one game to completion.
Play all four video games for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as the story opens them up — follow Andy's strand through each of its missions until the finale. If a strand seems to stall, advance the story: later missions unlock as chapters progress.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Follow Andy's stranger missions on the map until the final one.
If the strand stalls, play the next story chapter and check the map again.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Kenton is also tied to the treasure sets — the 100% checklist wants 5 of 7 Kenton Treasure Sets — so hunt his treasures while you work through his missions and let the two goals overlap.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Follow Kenton's stranger missions to the finale.
Collect Kenton's Treasure Sets along the way (5 of 7 for 100%).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Billy's missions unlock as you progress the story, so if his icon is not on the map yet, keep playing the main missions and check back between chapters.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Follow Billy's stranger missions to the finale.
Advance the story if his next mission has not appeared yet.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each named stranger — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and others — has a strand of several missions ending in a finale, and each finale has its own trophy. You need any 8 complete strands, so work through the strangers you meet as they appear and keep going until the eighth finale pops.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Start every stranger strand you find on the map.
Finish 8 strands completely — each finale also has its own trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Like the other stranger finales, it unlocks by playing Randy's missions in order as they appear; story progress gates the later ones, so do not expect to finish the strand in one visit.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Follow Randy's stranger missions to the finale.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Tyrone's missions appear as you move through the story — clear each one when it shows up, and the finale will unlock in its turn.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Follow Tyrone's stranger missions to the finale.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — but do the first one in Chapter 1 or risk locking the platinum. After the mission Down to Earth, go to Jason's house in the morning, speak to Lucia in the kitchen when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony, accept, and finish the meditation. That balcony session may be required and it does not come back. The other spots are marked meditation locations you can visit with either character; 15 of 18 count toward 100%, but this trophy needs all 18. Make a manual save right after the Chapter 1 meditation.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: go to Jason's house in the morning.
Talk to Lucia in the kitchen about meditating, follow her to the balcony, accept.
Finish the meditation, check the Progress counter moved, then make a manual save.
Meditate at the remaining marked spots across Leonida with Jason and Lucia (18 total).

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — one of the specific target animals on Bret's list. Use binoculars to study animals first (studying 100 species is a 100% checklist item), then track the marked target and take it down. Bret's full Target Deck is 15 objectives, all required for 100%, so keep working his list after this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Study animals with binoculars to learn the species around you.
Take Bret's marked unique-animal hunt and complete it.
Keep clearing Bret's Target Deck — 15 of 15 for 100%.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida, and the 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets — far more than this trophy — so treat card hunting as a long cleanup job: grab cards whenever you pass them and use the Progress counter to see which sets are close to complete. Finish any 3 sets and the silver pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards as you explore; each set needs every card in it.
Complete any 3 sets for this trophy.
Push on to 15 of 18 sets for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. WAiNK scans whatever you point it at — vehicles, landmarks, animals — so make it a habit from the start of the game: scan every new vehicle model and every landmark you pass. The same scans feed the 100% checklist (200 base-model vehicles, 100 animals studied), so early scanning saves hours of cleanup later.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan new vehicles, landmarks and animals as you meet them.
Scan early and often — 100 locations is the trophy, 200 vehicles is the 100% target.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's Challenges. There are 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and the 100% checklist wants 70 of them — so this trophy is a milestone on the way to 70, not a separate grind. Many challenges complete naturally while you chase other trophies; save the hardest 10 for last and skip them entirely, since 100% only needs 70.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Work challenges as they come up during other trophy hunting.
Reach 50 for this trophy, then 70 for the 100% checklist.
Skip the 10 hardest challenges — they are not needed.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape. The partner must be with you when the heat breaks — do it as a duo, not solo. Get the wanted level up in a quiet area, then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars fade. Hiding in alleys or water and swapping to a fresh car are the reliable ways to drop the search.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along, then raise a 4-star Wanted Level.
Break line of sight, swap vehicles and hide until the stars clear.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level — meaning the heat must stay on through all three robberies. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them in quick succession, and keep moving: lingering invites the cops to close in, but losing them entirely also fails the trophy. Fast driving between shops, not hiding, is the way through.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together and plan the route first.
Rob all three in succession with your partner, keeping the Wanted Level alive throughout.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or scan 100 different vehicle models. Scan each new model with the WAiNK app as you find it; that habit also feeds You WAiNKer! and the 100% checklist, which wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles. Car parks, traffic and dealerships are the fastest way to meet new models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Scan every new vehicle model with WAiNK as you meet it.
Reach 100 discoveries here, then 200 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single activation of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies group together — a gang hideout or a robbery shootout — then trigger Combat Focus and chain the kills before the meter runs out. Thin the group first if you need to: five quick takedowns inside one window is the whole ask.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight where enemies cluster together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport — an unscheduled departure, in the trophy's words. Wait on the runway area for a passenger jet taxiing for take-off, board it and get it airborne. Expect an immediate Wanted Level and a rough take-off: use the runway's full length and ignore the pursuit until you are in the air.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and watch for a passenger jet taxiing to depart.
Board it, take the runway and get airborne.

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos show up at military sites and in high-heat responses — wait for one to roll in, take it, and use its cannon in a fight. The tank is slow and draws every cop in the area, so pick an open spot with room to manoeuvre before you climb in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino at a military site or during a high Wanted Level.
Steal it and use its cannon in combat.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean, quiet job. Case the store first, go in when the street is empty, keep your weapon out of sight, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If a clerk or camera spots you, the trophy is gone for that attempt: leave, let the heat die, and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Case a jewelry store and enter when it is quiet.
Take the goods without being spotted — if detected, abort and retry later.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — five successful vault jobs, each ending with a clean getaway. The vaults open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4, and the 100% checklist wants all 8 of them. Plan the escape before the robbery: a fast car parked nearby, a route out of the city, and no hesitation once the alarm sounds.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Unlock the vaults via That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4.
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time; all 8 are needed for 100%.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, take the cash and get away before the response arrives. Blocking the road with your own vehicle is the simple way to stop one; hit it fast, grab the money and vanish.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route and block it.
Take the cash and escape before backup arrives.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. Drive, fly and sail into every region until the fog lifts from the whole map — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the northern towns. Check the map screen: greyed-out areas are the ones still unvisited. Combine this with collectible runs so the miles do double duty.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel to every region of Leonida — city, coast, swamp and north.
Check the map for greyed-out areas and visit them.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Illegal Operations are gang-run sites marked around the map; you need one hit per gang, not one per site. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit — the Progress menu tracks it — and work through the nine methodically. The 100% checklist wants all 39 Gang Operations, so these nine are a start on that total.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the nine gangs.
Track the gangs in Progress > Stats; all 39 operations count toward 100%.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guide sites — what is known is the place (Ocean Beach) and the act (a cocktail with a view). Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view over the water, order a cocktail and linger. This entry will be updated when a source confirms the precise trigger.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a spot with a view over the water.
Order a cocktail there. Exact trigger still being confirmed — check the sources linked below.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a drive-through exit, in the spirit of the classic GTA showroom escape. The precise method is still unconfirmed by the guide sites, so take a car inside a showroom and drive it straight out through the glass. This entry will be updated when a source confirms the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Take a car into a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the front.
Exact method still being confirmed — check the sources linked below.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, steal the three key valuables and escape. This is a robbery with a specific target list: get in, take all three valuables, and get out clean. Scout the alley first so you know where the three items are before you start the clock.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Steal the three key valuables and escape.

trophies.guide: Maximise the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Strength grows through physical activity — working out, fighting, and the activities that build it — so train both characters rather than favouring one. Check each character's stats to see who still needs work, and keep at it until both bars are full.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Train Strength with both Jason and Lucia — workouts and physical activity build it.
Check both characters' stats and keep training until both are maxed.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. This is a long grind of small choices: the things you do in the world — crimes, deals, encounters — feed the profile counter. It is reported by GTABase as the unlock method, from a single source, so treat the number as the guide's best current reading: play normally, make choices often, and watch the counter climb in Progress > Stats.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play through the game making choices — crimes, deals and encounters feed the profile.
Watch the Criminal Profile counter in Progress > Stats toward 500.

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something you failed once, but no guide has confirmed what. Do not chase this one early: play the game, fail and retry things as they come, and it may pop on its own. This entry will be updated when a source confirms the trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: No confirmed method yet — the description suggests a second attempt after a failure.
Keep playing; check the sources linked below for updates.

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method yet. The description reads like a reaction to something strange — an easter egg or an unexpected event in the world — but no guide has confirmed what triggers it. Explore Leonida's odd corners (the swamps, the Keys, the desert roads at night) and see what the world throws at you; this entry will be updated when a source confirms the trigger.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: No confirmed method yet — the description points at a strange world event.
Explore the odd corners of Leonida and check the sources linked below for updates.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl targets over with a melee drive-by — strike pedestrians (or bowling pins, in the joke of the name) with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed, but the shape of it is clear: drive by and swing a melee weapon from the car. Try it on a quiet road with a few targets around, and keep an eye on the guide sources for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: From a moving vehicle, hit targets with a melee weapon.
Precise method still being confirmed — check the sources linked below.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; your contacts clean them for a cut. The same $250,000 also counts toward the 100% checklist, so every bill you launder does double duty. Keep robbing, keep laundering, and the counter climbs — there is no single big job, just volume.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Rob for Marked Bills, then launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total — the same figure counts for 100%.

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. Everything you buy counts — weapons, clothes, food, car mods — so this one pops naturally if you shop as you play. If it is the last one standing, the fastest way through is to buy and sell high-value items, or simply kit out a car you love: mods eat money quickly.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Shop normally as you play — weapons, clothes, car mods all count.
Spend $100,000 in total across every shop.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties. Garages are bought from the property listings around Leonida — each one costs money, so fund them from robbery earnings (the laundering and fencing totals feed your wallet as you go). Buy them as you can afford them; owning all eight pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Earn money from robberies and fencing.
Buy all 8 garage properties from the listings.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you want to keep, open the Scooter Bros app and register them — ten registrations is the ask. Rare and useful cars are worth registering first, since the app is also how you get them back.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Find vehicles worth keeping.
Register 10 of them through the Scooter Bros app.
